verdict.rationale: Quo is a communications API platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only a production server (api.quo.com), and the API reference's 'Try it' playground runs against the production API with a real key. The 7-day free trial is an account trial, not an isolated sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
